metadata.title: SC/ST Government Schemes — Comprehensive Dataset
metadata.coverage: Central Government + Gujarat + Rajasthan + Madhya Pradesh + Maharashtra

central_government_schemes.scheme_name: Pre-Matric Scholarship for SC Students (Classes IX & X)
central_government_schemes.description: Monthly scholarship to SC students in Classes 9 and 10 to prevent dropout and ease transition to secondary education.
central_government_schemes.benefits: Day Scholar: Rs. 150–350/month + Rs. 750 ad hoc; Hosteller: Rs. 350–750/month + Rs. 1,000 ad hoc
application_process: Fill form with caste & income details
central_government_schemes.language_summary_hi: SC छात्रों को कक्षा 9-10 में पढ़ाई न छोड़ने के लिए मासिक छात्रवृत्ति।
conflict_flags: Central income ceiling Rs. 2.5 lakh; many state schemes use Rs. 1 lakh ceiling — students with income Rs. 1–2.5 lakh may qualify centrally but NOT under state scheme.

central_government_schemes.scheme_name: Pre-Matric Scholarship for ST Students (Classes IX & X)
central_government_schemes.description: Monthly scholarship to ST students in Classes 9 and 10 to prevent dropout.
central_government_schemes.benefits: Day Scholar: Rs. 150/month; Hosteller: Rs. 350/month; disability allowance extra
central_government_schemes.language_summary_hi: ST छात्रों को कक्षा 9-10 में मासिक छात्रवृत्ति।

central_government_schemes.scheme_name: Post-Matric Scholarship for SC Students
central_government_schemes.description: Financial assistance to SC students from Class XI up to post-graduate level including professional and technical courses.
central_government_schemes.benefits: Maintenance allowance Rs. 380–1,200/month by course level; full tuition & exam fee reimbursement; book allowance; thesis allowance for research students
central_government_schemes.language_summary_hi: SC छात्रों को Class XI से PG तक पढ़ाई के लिए छात्रवृत्ति।
conflict_flags: Central income limit Rs. 2.5 lakh; Gujarat, Rajasthan and MP state equivalents have Rs. 1.5–2 lakh limits — DIRECT CONFLICT for students with income Rs. 1.5–2.5 lakh.

central_government_schemes.scheme_name: Post-Matric Scholarship for ST Students
central_government_schemes.description: Financial assistance to ST students from Class XI up to post-graduate level.
central_government_schemes.benefits: Maintenance allowance Rs. 380–1,200/month; full tuition & exam fee; book-bank facility; study tour charges
application_process: Upload ST certificate and income proof
central_government_schemes.language_summary_hi: ST छात्रों को Class XI से PG तक छात्रवृत्ति।
conflict_flags: Gujarat state ST scheme income limit Rs. 2 lakh vs central Rs. 2.5 lakh — students earning Rs. 2–2.5 lakh qualify centrally but NOT under Gujarat state scheme — DIRECT CONFLICT.

central_government_schemes.scheme_name: Top Class Education Scheme for SC Students
central_government_schemes.description: Full financial support to meritorious SC students admitted to premier institutes (IITs, IIMs, AIIMS, NITs, NLUs).

eligibility.class: Post-Class XII at notified premier institutes

central_government_schemes.benefits: Full tuition & non-refundable fees; Rs. 2,220–2,500/month maintenance; Rs. 45,000/year books; Rs. 45,000 computer grant
application_process: Check if institute is on notified list at socialjustice.gov.in
central_government_schemes.language_summary_hi: IIT, IIM, AIIMS में पढ़ने वाले SC छात्रों की पूरी फीस और खर्च सरकार देती है।

central_government_schemes.scheme_name: National Overseas Scholarship for SC/ST
central_government_schemes.ministry: Ministry of Social Justice & Empowerment / Ministry of Tribal Affairs
central_government_schemes.description: Financial assistance to meritorious SC and ST students for Masters and PhD programmes at foreign universities.
central_government_schemes.benefits: Full tuition fee; living allowance as per country norms; travel; contingency grant; visa fee reimbursement
application_process: Apply at socialjustice.gov.in or tribal.nic.in during notification period
central_government_schemes.language_summary_hi: SC/ST मेधावी छात्रों को विदेश में Masters/PhD की पढ़ाई के लिए पूरी छात्रवृत्ति।

central_government_schemes.scheme_name: Eklavya Model Residential Schools (EMRS)
central_government_schemes.description: Residential schools with quality education for ST students in tribal-dominated blocks (at least 50% ST population).

eligibility.domicile: State where school is located; preference to local tribal children

central_government_schemes.benefits: Free residential education including board, lodging, books, uniform; extracurricular, sports and cultural facilities; 728 schools targeted by 2026
application_process: Apply at nearest EMRS during annual admission drive
Residential admission confirmed by EMRS principal
central_government_schemes.language_summary_hi: आदिवासी बहुल क्षेत्रों में ST बच्चों के लिए मुफ्त आवासीय स्कूल।

central_government_schemes.scheme_name: Babu Jagjivan Ram Chhatrawas Yojana (BJRCY) — Hostels for SC Students
central_government_schemes.description: Provides grant to states/UTs to construct new hostel buildings for SC boys and girls studying at secondary level and above.

eligibility.gender: All (separate hostels for boys and girls)

central_government_schemes.benefits: Free or subsidised hostel accommodation; Rs. 3,000/student/month food bill subsidy in government hostels
application_process: Apply at college hostel warden or District SC Welfare Office
Hostel seat allotted on availability basis
Income and caste verified before allotment
central_government_schemes.language_summary_hi: SC छात्रों को सरकारी छात्रावास में मुफ्त या सब्सिडाइज्ड रहने की सुविधा।

central_government_schemes.scheme_name: Van Dhan Vikas Kendras (VDVK) — Tribal Livelihoods
central_government_schemes.description: Cluster of 15 Self-Help Groups (300 tribal beneficiaries) working on value addition of Minor Forest Produce (MFP) and traditional tribal goods.

eligibility.occupation: Forest produce collectors, tribal artisans, craftspeople

central_government_schemes.benefits: Working capital Rs. 15 lakh per VDVK cluster; skill training; market linkage via TRIFED; branding support under 'Tribes India'
documents_required: SHG membership proof or willingness to form SHG
application_process: Contact State Tribal Cooperative Marketing Federation
Apply for VDVK registration via State Tribal Dept
central_government_schemes.language_summary_hi: आदिवासियों को वनोपज के मूल्य संवर्धन और बिक्री में मदद — Van Dhan Kendras।

central_government_schemes.scheme_name: National Scheduled Castes Finance and Development Corporation (NSFDC) — Loan Schemes
central_government_schemes.description: Provides concessional loans through State Channelising Agencies (SCAs) to SC persons below double poverty line for income-generating activities.

eligibility.income_limit: Annual family income up to Rs. 3 lakh (urban) / Rs. 2.5 lakh (rural)

central_government_schemes.benefits: Term Loan: up to Rs. 15 lakh at 6% (men) / 5% (women); Mahila Samridhi Yojana: up to Rs. 50,000 at 1%; Education Loan: up to Rs. 20 lakh at 4%
documents_required: Business plan or education admission letter
application_process: Apply at State SC Development Corporation (SCA)
Submit caste, income and business documents
SCA evaluates and forwards to NSFDC
central_government_schemes.language_summary_hi: SC परिवारों को रोजगार के लिए सस्ते दर पर कर्ज — NSFDC के जरिए।

central_government_schemes.scheme_name: National Scheduled Tribes Finance and Development Corporation (NSTFDC) — Loan Schemes
central_government_schemes.description: Concessional loans to ST persons below double the poverty line for income-generating activities.

eligibility.income_limit: Annual family income up to Rs. 3 lakh (urban) / Rs. 2.5 lakh (rural)

central_government_schemes.benefits: General Term Loan: up to Rs. 20 lakh at 6%; Micro Finance: up to Rs. 50,000 at 4%; Adivasi Mahila Sashaktikaran Yojana: up to Rs. 1 lakh at 4% for women
application_process: Apply at State Tribal Finance Corporation
Loan forwarded and sanctioned by NSTFDC
central_government_schemes.language_summary_hi: ST परिवारों को आजीविका के लिए NSTFDC से कम ब्याज पर ऋण।

central_government_schemes.scheme_name: Special Central Assistance to SC Sub-Plan (SCA to SCSP)
central_government_schemes.description: Grant to states to supplement efforts in economic development of SC families — primarily those below poverty line — through skill training and asset transfer.
central_government_schemes.benefits: Training allowance Rs. 1,000/month during skill training; tool kit worth up to Rs. 3,000; revolving fund for self-employment; subsidy for SC entrepreneurs
application_process: Applied through District SC Welfare Office
State submits annual SC Sub-Plan to Ministry
Funds released to states for implementation
central_government_schemes.language_summary_hi: BPL SC परिवारों के आर्थिक विकास के लिए कौशल प्रशिक्षण और संपत्ति सहायता।

central_government_schemes.scheme_name: Pradhan Mantri Adi Adarsh Gram Yojana (PMAAGY)
central_government_schemes.description: Integrated development of villages with at least 50% ST population to bridge infrastructure gaps across education, health, roads, and housing.

eligibility.caste: ST (village-level scheme, benefits all residents of notified tribal villages)

central_government_schemes.benefits: Convergence of 58 central government schemes; village development plan; roads, clean water, electricity, health sub-centers; Rs. 7,276 crore allocated for 36,428 tribal villages
application_process: No individual application — Gram Panchayat registers village under PMAAGY
central_government_schemes.language_summary_hi: 50% से अधिक आदिवासी आबादी वाले गांवों का समग्र विकास — सड़क, पानी, बिजली, स्वास्थ्य।

central_government_schemes.scheme_name: Pradhan Mantri Jan Jatiya Vikas Mission (PMJJVM) — Tribal Entrepreneurship
central_government_schemes.description: Promotes tribal entrepreneurship under the 'Vocal for Local by Tribal' initiative through market linkages and Van Dhan Kendras.
central_government_schemes.benefits: Enterprise grants; market linkage through TRIFED and Tribes India; e-commerce platform access; branding and packaging support
application_process: Contact TRIFED regional office or State Tribal Dept
Linked with Van Dhan Kendra or TRIFED supply chain
central_government_schemes.language_summary_hi: आदिवासी उद्यमियों को बाजार तक पहुंच — 'ट्राइब्स इंडिया' के जरिए।

central_government_schemes.scheme_name: SC/ST Hub — MSME for SC/ST Entrepreneurs
central_government_schemes.description: Promotes SC/ST entrepreneurs in public procurement and provides training, mentoring, handholding and credit facilitation.
central_government_schemes.benefits: Mentorship and handholding; help with GeM (Government e-Marketplace) registration; linkage to MUDRA, Stand Up India; market development assistance
application_process: Connect with nearest MSME Development Institute (MSME-DI)
central_government_schemes.language_summary_hi: SC/ST उद्यमियों को सरकारी खरीद में भागीदारी और MSME सहयोग।

central_government_schemes.scheme_name: Pradhan Mantri Awas Yojana — Gramin (PMAY-G) — SC/ST Priority
central_government_schemes.description: Housing scheme prioritizing SC/ST households for pucca house construction in rural areas.

eligibility.caste: SC and ST are priority categories (over 60% of allocation mandated for SC/ST)

central_government_schemes.benefits: Rs. 1.20 lakh (plains) or Rs. 1.30 lakh (hilly areas); MGNREGS wages for construction; free toilet under SBM
application_process: Geo-tagged photo upload for installment release
central_government_schemes.language_summary_hi: SC/ST BPL परिवारों को पक्का घर बनाने के लिए 1.20 लाख रुपए की सहायता।
conflict_flags: Central scheme uses SECC-2011 list; state-level housing schemes for SC/ST use separate state BPL/caste lists — a family in SECC may miss out on state top-ups if not on state BPL list.

central_government_schemes.scheme_name: Scheduled Caste Sub-Plan / Tribal Sub-Plan — Housing Component
central_government_schemes.ministry: Ministry of Housing & Urban Affairs / Ministry of Rural Development
central_government_schemes.description: Mandated allocation of funds proportional to SC/ST population in state budgets for housing and infrastructure; ensures state housing schemes carve out resources for SC/ST.
central_government_schemes.benefits: State-specific housing grants and subsidies; construction material support; land pattas in some states
documents_required: Land ownership proof or landlessness certificate
application_process: Apply at Gram Panchayat or District Collector office
central_government_schemes.language_summary_hi: SC/ST के लिए राज्य बजट में आरक्षित आवास राशि के तहत घर निर्माण सहायता।

central_government_schemes.scheme_name: Pradhan Mantri Jan Arogya Yojana (PMJAY) — SC/ST Priority
central_government_schemes.description: Health insurance of Rs. 5 lakh/family/year — SECC-listed SC/ST households are automatic beneficiaries (D3/D4 deprivation categories).

eligibility.caste: SC/ST households listed under SECC 2011 D3/D4 deprivation auto-included

central_government_schemes.benefits: Rs. 5 lakh/year cashless health cover; 1,929 treatment packages; empanelled hospitals across India
application_process: Check eligibility at pmjay.gov.in or CSC
Visit empanelled hospital for cashless treatment
central_government_schemes.language_summary_hi: SECC में दर्ज SC/ST परिवारों को 5 लाख रुपए तक का मुफ्त इलाज।
conflict_flags: PMJAY uses SECC-2011 data; state health schemes (e.g., Gujarat MA Yojana, Rajasthan Chiranjeevi) use state BPL lists — SC/ST families in SECC but not state list may miss state top-up benefits.

central_government_schemes.scheme_name: National Tribal Health Mission — ST Health Initiatives
central_government_schemes.ministry: Ministry of Health & Family Welfare / Ministry of Tribal Affairs
central_government_schemes.description: Focused health delivery for ST communities including mobile health units, ASHA workers, sickle cell disease management, and malaria control in tribal areas.
central_government_schemes.benefits: Mobile Medical Units (MMUs) visiting tribal villages; sickle cell screening and treatment; TB treatment with nutritional support; Rs. 500 incentive for institutional delivery (JSY-linked)
application_process: Access via nearest PHC, MMU visit, or ASHA worker
No separate application for health services — registration at PHC
central_government_schemes.language_summary_hi: आदिवासी इलाकों में ST परिवारों के लिए मोबाइल स्वास्थ्य सेवाएं, सिकल सेल जांच और मलेरिया नियंत्रण।

central_government_schemes.scheme_name: Namo Drone Didi / PM SHRI — SC/ST Focus
central_government_schemes.ministry: Ministry of Agriculture / Ministry of Education
central_government_schemes.description: PM SHRI schools include SC/ST-dominated government schools for quality upgradation; Drone Didi scheme targets SHGs with significant SC/ST membership for drone-based agriculture services.

eligibility.caste: SC/ST SHG members (Drone Didi); SC/ST students in PM SHRI schools (education)
eligibility.age_limit: 18+ for SHGs; school age for PM SHRI

central_government_schemes.benefits: Drone Didi: Free drone + training + Rs. 15,000/month income potential; PM SHRI: upgraded school infrastructure for SC/ST students
application_process: Drone Didi: Apply through Krishi Vigyan Kendra or NABARD via SHG
PM SHRI: School auto-selected by Ministry; no individual application
central_government_schemes.language_summary_hi: SC/ST महिला SHG को ड्रोन दीदी योजना से ड्रोन, प्रशिक्षण और कमाई का मौका।

gujarat_state_schemes.description: Pre-SSC scholarship for SC students from Class I to X to encourage school attendance and reduce dropout.
gujarat_state_schemes.benefits: Rs. 10–100/month varying by class level; uniform assistance
application_process: Apply at school / District SC Welfare Office
gujarat_state_schemes.language_summary_hi: SC छात्रों को Class 1-10 में मासिक छात्रवृत्ति।
conflict_flags: Income limit Rs. 1.5 lakh in Gujarat vs Rs. 2.5 lakh under central Pre-Matric scheme — DIRECT CONFLICT: student with income Rs. 1.5–2.5 lakh qualifies centrally but not under Gujarat state scheme.

gujarat_state_schemes.scheme_name: Saraswati Sadhana Yojana — Free Cycle for SC Girls (Class IX)
gujarat_state_schemes.description: Free bicycle for SC girl students studying in Class 9 to reduce dropout and ease commute to school.
gujarat_state_schemes.benefits: One free bicycle worth approximately Rs. 3,000–4,500
application_process: Apply through school to District SC Welfare Office
Eligibility verified by school and dept
Bicycle distributed at school or district level
gujarat_state_schemes.language_summary_hi: SC कन्याओं को Class 9 में मुफ्त साइकिल ताकि स्कूल तक आना-जाना आसान हो।

gujarat_state_schemes.scheme_name: Bhagwan Buddha Post-SSC Scholarship for SC Girls (BCK-5)
gujarat_state_schemes.description: State post-SSC scholarship exclusively for SC girl students pursuing higher education.
gujarat_state_schemes.benefits: Maintenance allowance; tuition fee reimbursement (state portion); hostel bill support
gujarat_state_schemes.language_summary_hi: SC कन्याओं को Class XI के बाद उच्च शिक्षा के लिए छात्रवृत्ति।

gujarat_state_schemes.scheme_name: NEET/JEE Coaching Fee Assistance for SC Students (BCK-354)
gujarat_state_schemes.description: Coaching fee assistance to SC students in Class 12 science stream for NEET and JEE competitive exam preparation.
gujarat_state_schemes.benefits: Coaching fee reimbursement up to Rs. 1.5 lakh at empanelled coaching institutes
application_process: Apply at District SC Welfare Office
Coaching institute must be on approved list
gujarat_state_schemes.deadline: Rolling / at time of coaching enrollment
gujarat_state_schemes.language_summary_hi: SC छात्रों को NEET/JEE कोचिंग की फीस सरकार देती है।

gujarat_state_schemes.scheme_name: Dr. Ambedkar Awas Yojana (SC Housing) — Gujarat
gujarat_state_schemes.department: Director, Scheduled Caste Welfare / Gujarat SC Development Corporation
gujarat_state_schemes.description: State top-up housing assistance for SC families in addition to PMAY-G to construct pucca houses.

eligibility.land: Must own or be allotted homestead land

gujarat_state_schemes.benefits: Additional Rs. 50,000 state top-up over PMAY-G central grant; total house assistance up to Rs. 1.70 lakh
application_process: Apply at Gram Panchayat (rural) or Municipal Corporation (urban)
Documents submitted to District SC Welfare Office
State top-up released after central release
gujarat_state_schemes.language_summary_hi: Gujarat में SC परिवारों को PMAY के अलावा 50,000 रुपए का अतिरिक्त आवास अनुदान।
conflict_flags: Central PMAY-G requires SECC-2011 listing only; Gujarat state scheme additionally requires Gujarat Domicile Certificate — migrant SC families in SECC but lacking domicile proof may miss state top-up — DIRECT CONFLICT.

gujarat_state_schemes.scheme_name: Swami Vivekanand Scholarship for ST Students in ITI (VKY)
gujarat_state_schemes.description: Scholarship for ST students enrolled in ITI (Industrial Training Institute) vocational courses.
gujarat_state_schemes.benefits: Monthly stipend Rs. 500–1,000; tool kit assistance; hostel bill support
application_process: Apply through ITI principal to District Tribal Welfare Office
Documents forwarded to state Tribal Dept
gujarat_state_schemes.language_summary_hi: ITI में पढ़ने वाले ST छात्रों को मासिक वजीफा और टूलकिट सहायता।

gujarat_state_schemes.scheme_name: VKY-32 Housing on Individual Basis — ST Tribal Housing (Gujarat)
gujarat_state_schemes.description: State individual housing assistance for ST families living in tribal areas to construct or repair pucca houses.

eligibility.income_limit: Below poverty line / annual income Rs. 1.5 lakh
eligibility.land: Must own or be allotted homestead land

gujarat_state_schemes.benefits: Grant of Rs. 1.20–1.50 lakh for new construction; Rs. 50,000 for major repair; convergence with PMAY-G for eligible households
application_process: Apply at Taluka Tribal Welfare Office
Field verification by tribal dept officer
Approval by District Tribal Development Officer
gujarat_state_schemes.language_summary_hi: गुजरात में ST परिवारों को आवास निर्माण के लिए 1.20–1.50 लाख रुपए की सहायता।

gujarat_state_schemes.scheme_name: VKY-34 Kunvarbainu Mameru / Sat Fera Samuh Lagna — Social Encouragement Scheme
gujarat_state_schemes.description: Financial and material assistance at time of marriage for ST girls from poor tribal families; also supports mass wedding events.

eligibility.income_limit: Annual family income Rs. 1.5 lakh or below
eligibility.age_limit: Girl: 18 years and above; Boy: 21 years and above

gujarat_state_schemes.benefits: Rs. 12,000 in cash + household items (utensils, saree set, etc.) worth Rs. 10,000 for individual marriage; mass wedding events organised by state
application_process: Apply at Taluka Tribal Welfare Office before or after marriage
Cash and gifts provided at event or credited to account
gujarat_state_schemes.language_summary_hi: ST परिवार की बेटी की शादी पर 12,000 रुपए नकद और घरेलू सामान।

gujarat_state_schemes.scheme_name: TASP Horticulture Development Programme in Tribal Areas (HRT-3)
gujarat_state_schemes.department: Tribal Development Department / Agriculture Dept, Gujarat
gujarat_state_schemes.description: Horticulture development in tribal scheduled areas through subsidy on inputs, planting material and drip irrigation.

eligibility.land: Must have land ownership (7/12 in name)

gujarat_state_schemes.benefits: 50–75% subsidy on drip irrigation; free planting material for horticultural crops; input kit subsidy
application_process: Apply on ikhedut.gujarat.gov.in under TASP sub-scheme
gujarat_state_schemes.language_summary_hi: गुजरात के आदिवासी इलाकों में ST किसानों को बागवानी के लिए 50–75% सब्सिडी।
conflict_flags: TASP scheme requires tribal area domicile AND 7/12 land ownership; PM-KISAN allows tenant/oral lessee — ST tenant farmers in tribal areas get PM-KISAN but are excluded from iKhedut/TASP horticulture subsidy — DIRECT CONFLICT.

gujarat_state_schemes.scheme_name: Namo Shri Yojana — Maternity Benefit for SC/ST Women (Gujarat 2024)
gujarat_state_schemes.description: Announced in Gujarat Budget 2024-25 — provides Rs. 12,000 nutrition and health assistance to pregnant and lactating women from 11 categories including SC and ST.

eligibility.caste: SC and ST (among 11 eligible categories including NFSA and PMJAY beneficiaries)

gujarat_state_schemes.benefits: Rs. 12,000 in total (released in installments linked to ANC visits and institutional delivery)
application_process: Register at Anganwadi Centre or Government Hospital
Linked with ASHA worker for tracking
gujarat_state_schemes.deadline: During pregnancy / within 1 year of delivery
gujarat_state_schemes.language_summary_hi: Gujarat में SC/ST गर्भवती और स्तनपान कराने वाली महिलाओं को 12,000 रुपए की पोषण सहायता।
conflict_flags: Central PMMVY gives Rs. 5,000 for first child; Gujarat Namo Shri gives Rs. 12,000 for SC/ST/NFSA. Benefits can be claimed simultaneously but installment conditions differ — PMMVY requires husband's Aadhaar while Namo Shri only requires MCP card — potential documentation conflict.

rajasthan_state_schemes.scheme_name: Mukhyamantri Anuprati Coaching Yojana — SC/ST Free Coaching
rajasthan_state_schemes.description: Free coaching for SC/ST/OBC/MBC/EWS students for competitive exams like IAS, RAS, IIT-JEE, NEET, SI, Constable, REET.

eligibility.caste: SC or ST (also OBC, MBC, EWS)
eligibility.income_limit: Annual family income up to Rs. 8 lakh

rajasthan_state_schemes.benefits: Free coaching at empanelled institutes; Rs. 40,000/year (Class XII level exams); Rs. 50,000/year (graduation level exams); stipend for living expenses for outstation students
application_process: Apply at sje.rajasthan.gov.in during application window
rajasthan_state_schemes.language_summary_hi: Rajasthan में SC/ST छात्रों को IAS, NEET, JEE जैसे परीक्षाओं की मुफ्त कोचिंग।

rajasthan_state_schemes.scheme_name: Kalibai Bheel Medhavi Chhatra Scooty Yojana — ST/SC Girls
rajasthan_state_schemes.description: Free scooty to meritorious SC/ST girl students who pass Class 12 and enroll in higher education.

eligibility.class: Passed Class 12 and enrolled in higher education
eligibility.income_limit: Family income up to Rs. 2.5 lakh/year

rajasthan_state_schemes.benefits: Free electric scooty worth Rs. 40,000–45,000 (or Rs. 40,000 cash if already has vehicle); 5,000 scooties distributed annually
application_process: Apply via Scholarship Portal or offline at college
rajasthan_state_schemes.language_summary_hi: Class 12 में अच्छे अंक लाने वाली SC/ST छात्राओं को मुफ्त स्कूटी।

rajasthan_state_schemes.description: State-level post-matriculation scholarship for SC students supplementing central post-matric scholarship.
rajasthan_state_schemes.benefits: Maintenance allowance; tuition fee reimbursement (state share — 40% of centrally sponsored scheme)
rajasthan_state_schemes.language_summary_hi: Rajasthan में SC छात्रों को Class XI से उच्च शिक्षा के लिए राज्य छात्रवृत्ति।

rajasthan_state_schemes.description: State scholarship for ST students studying from Class XI onwards with state-specific domicile requirement.
rajasthan_state_schemes.benefits: Maintenance allowance; fee reimbursement (state portion); hostel support
rajasthan_state_schemes.language_summary_hi: Rajasthan में ST छात्रों को उच्च शिक्षा के लिए राज्य छात्रवृत्ति।

rajasthan_state_schemes.scheme_name: Palanhar Yojana — Rajasthan SC/ST Orphan Child Support
rajasthan_state_schemes.description: Financial assistance to families raising orphaned or destitute SC/ST children (and children of death row convicts, widows, etc.) in family-like environment instead of institutions.

eligibility.caste: SC/ST (Palanhar — person raising the child — can be any community; child must be SC/ST or from notified categories)
eligibility.income_limit: Palanhar family annual income up to Rs. 1.20 lakh

rajasthan_state_schemes.benefits: Rs. 500/month per child (0–6 years); Rs. 1,000/month (6–18 years, must be in school); Rs. 2,000/year for clothing and other expenses
application_process: Apply at e-mitra kiosk or District Social Welfare Office
rajasthan_state_schemes.language_summary_hi: अनाथ या निराश्रित SC/ST बच्चों की देखरेख करने वाले परिवारों को हर महीने 500–1,000 रुपए।

rajasthan_state_schemes.scheme_name: Rajasthan Tribal Area Development (TADA) Housing Scheme
rajasthan_state_schemes.description: Housing assistance for ST families in Rajasthan's scheduled tribal areas (Banswara, Dungarpur, Pratapgarh etc.) for construction or repair.

eligibility.income_limit: BPL / SECC or annual income below Rs. 1.5 lakh

rajasthan_state_schemes.benefits: Rs. 1.30 lakh for new pucca house construction; Rs. 50,000 for major repair; convergence with PMAY-G for eligible beneficiaries
application_process: Apply at Gram Panchayat or Taluka Tribal Welfare Office
Approval by District Tribal Development Officer
rajasthan_state_schemes.language_summary_hi: Rajasthan के आदिवासी इलाकों में ST परिवारों को मकान निर्माण के लिए 1.30 लाख रुपए।

rajasthan_state_schemes.scheme_name: Rajasthan SC/ST Atrocities Relief Rehabilitation — Economic Assistance
rajasthan_state_schemes.description: Economic rehabilitation assistance to SC/ST victims of atrocities under the SC/ST (Prevention of Atrocities) Act 1989.

eligibility.condition: Must be victim/survivor of atrocity registered under SC/ST POA Act

rajasthan_state_schemes.benefits: Compensation Rs. 85,000–8.25 lakh (as per nature of atrocity); immediate Rs. 25,000 relief; rehabilitation package including housing, employment, and education support
documents_required: FIR copy under SC/ST POA Act
application_process: File FIR at police station under SC/ST POA Act
Compensation released in stages per court direction
rajasthan_state_schemes.deadline: N/A (relief must be provided within notified timelines under POA Act)
rajasthan_state_schemes.language_summary_hi: SC/ST अत्याचार पीड़ितों को मुआवजा, पुनर्वास और आर्थिक सहायता।

madhya_pradesh_state_schemes.scheme_name: MP Post-Matric Scholarship for ST Students (MPTAAS)
madhya_pradesh_state_schemes.department: Tribal Affairs & Scheduled Caste Welfare Department, MP
madhya_pradesh_state_schemes.description: State post-matric scholarship for ST students channelled through MPTAAS (Madhya Pradesh Tribal Affairs Automation System).

eligibility.marks: Regular admission; no minimum marks for continuation

madhya_pradesh_state_schemes.benefits: Tuition fee + exam fee reimbursement; maintenance allowance Rs. 380–1,200/month; hostel food bill reimbursement
application_process: Register beneficiary profile on MPTAAS portal (tribal.mp.gov.in)
madhya_pradesh_state_schemes.language_summary_hi: MP में ST छात्रों को Class XI से उच्च शिक्षा के लिए छात्रवृत्ति और फीस माफी।
conflict_flags: MP state income limit Rs. 6 lakh for ST (higher than central Rs. 2.5 lakh) — here MP is MORE generous; however for SC, MP state income limit may differ — cross-check required.

madhya_pradesh_state_schemes.scheme_name: MP ST Student Emergency Welfare Fund (Class I–X)
madhya_pradesh_state_schemes.description: Emergency financial assistance to ST students in Classes 1–10 for medical emergencies, disasters, disability support and participation in cultural/sports events.

eligibility.school: Government or accredited school in MP

madhya_pradesh_state_schemes.benefits: Rs. 25,000 for untimely calamity/emergency; Rs. 3,000 for participation in special events (sports, cultural, scientific); Rs. 3,000 for tricycle (disability); up to Rs. 25,000 for serious disease (cancer, TB, heart disease)
application_process: School processes via MP Education Portal
madhya_pradesh_state_schemes.language_summary_hi: MP में ST छात्रों को आपात स्थिति, बीमारी या दुर्घटना में 25,000 रुपए की तत्काल सहायता।

madhya_pradesh_state_schemes.scheme_name: MP Tribal Housing Assistance — Higher Education Outside Hometown
madhya_pradesh_state_schemes.department: Tribal Affairs & SC Welfare Department, MP
madhya_pradesh_state_schemes.description: Housing (accommodation) assistance for tribal students pursuing higher education in cities where government hostels are unavailable.

eligibility.class: Graduate, graduate diploma, technical, or paramedical courses
eligibility.condition: Government hostel facility not available at place of study; must be regularly admitted

madhya_pradesh_state_schemes.benefits: Rs. 1,000–2,000/month accommodation allowance; support for boys and girls
documents_required: Proof of non-availability of government hostel
application_process: Submit accommodation details and admission proof
Verified by Hostel Superintendent or VKEO
madhya_pradesh_state_schemes.language_summary_hi: MP के ST छात्रों को शहर में पढ़ाई के लिए किराये के घर पर मासिक सहायता।

madhya_pradesh_state_schemes.scheme_name: MP SC Post-Matric Scholarship (State Scholarship Portal)
madhya_pradesh_state_schemes.description: State scholarship for SC students from Class XI onwards via the MP Scholarship Portal.
madhya_pradesh_state_schemes.benefits: Maintenance allowance; tuition and exam fee reimbursement; hostel support
madhya_pradesh_state_schemes.language_summary_hi: MP में SC छात्रों को उच्च शिक्षा के लिए छात्रवृत्ति।

madhya_pradesh_state_schemes.scheme_name: Jabali Scheme — ST Tribal Women Rehabilitation (MP)
madhya_pradesh_state_schemes.description: Rehabilitation scheme launched in 2014 for Bediya, Bachada, and Sansi tribe women in MP to rescue them from forced prostitution and provide economic livelihood.

eligibility.condition: Must be victim of forced prostitution / destitute

madhya_pradesh_state_schemes.benefits: Rescue, rehabilitation housing, vocational training, Rs. 5,000/month stipend for 2 years, linkage to self-employment
application_process: Referral by social worker / ASHA / NGO
District Tribal Welfare Office coordinates rescue
Stipend and training delivered at rehabilitation centre
madhya_pradesh_state_schemes.language_summary_hi: MP में ST समुदाय की शोषित महिलाओं को पुनर्वास, प्रशिक्षण और मासिक सहायता।

madhya_pradesh_state_schemes.scheme_name: MP SC/ST Atrocities Act Victim Compensation & Rehabilitation
madhya_pradesh_state_schemes.description: Compensation and rehabilitation to SC/ST atrocity victims per the SC/ST (Prevention of Atrocities) Act 1989 and 2016 Amendment.

eligibility.condition: Victim of atrocity under POA Act

madhya_pradesh_state_schemes.benefits: Immediate Rs. 25,000 relief; total compensation Rs. 85,000–8.25 lakh per offence type; housing, food and medical support; educational support for children
application_process: Relief provided within 24 hours of atrocity
madhya_pradesh_state_schemes.language_summary_hi: MP में SC/ST अत्याचार पीड़ितों को तत्काल राहत, मुआवजा और पुनर्वास।

maharashtra_state_schemes.scheme_name: Bharatratna Dr. Babasaheb Ambedkar Swadhar Yojana (Maharashtra SC)
maharashtra_state_schemes.department: Social Justice & Special Assistance Dept, Maharashtra
maharashtra_state_schemes.description: Financial assistance for SC students studying in Classes XI, XII and higher courses outside their hometown where government hostels are unavailable.

eligibility.income_limit: Family income up to Rs. 2.5 lakh/year

maharashtra_state_schemes.benefits: Rs. 51,000/year (arts/commerce); Rs. 63,000/year (science); Rs. 1,10,000/year (professional courses); covers board, lodging, and other expenses
documents_required: Proof of no government hostel availability
maharashtra_state_schemes.deadline: March 31, 2026 for 2024–25 (extended); usually November each year
maharashtra_state_schemes.language_summary_hi: Maharashtra में SC छात्रों को बाहर पढ़ने के लिए बोर्डिंग और रहने का खर्च सरकार देती है।

maharashtra_state_schemes.scheme_name: Maharashtra SC Post-Matric Scholarship — MahaDBT (Tuition Fee + Exam Fee)
maharashtra_state_schemes.department: Social Justice & Special Assistance Dept, Maharashtra
maharashtra_state_schemes.description: Full tuition fee and exam fee reimbursement for SC students in post-matric courses via MahaDBT portal.

eligibility.class: XI and above (all post-matric including professional)
eligibility.income_limit: Rs. 2.5 lakh/year (Scholarship); above Rs. 2.5 lakh up to Rs. 8 lakh (Freeship — fee only)

maharashtra_state_schemes.benefits: Scholarship (<Rs.2.5L income): 100% tuition fee + exam fee + maintenance allowance; Freeship (Rs.2.5–8L income): 100% tuition fee + exam fee only (no maintenance allowance)
application_process: Upload caste, income, and admission documents
maharashtra_state_schemes.language_summary_hi: Maharashtra में SC छात्रों की पूरी ट्यूशन फीस और परीक्षा शुल्क सरकार भरती है।

maharashtra_state_schemes.scheme_name: Maharashtra ST Post-Matric Scholarship — MahaDBT (Tuition Fee & Exam Fee Freeship)
maharashtra_state_schemes.description: Tuition fee and exam fee reimbursement for ST students in Maharashtra post-matric courses including professional and technical degrees.

eligibility.income_limit: Rs. 2.5 lakh (scholarship); up to Rs. 8 lakh (freeship)
eligibility.attendance: 75% monthly attendance required; must appear in both semester exams

maharashtra_state_schemes.benefits: 100% tuition fee + exam fee; maintenance allowance (for income < Rs. 2.5 lakh); special allowance Rs. 160/month for disabled students
maharashtra_state_schemes.language_summary_hi: Maharashtra में ST छात्रों की पूरी फीस माफ — माहाDBT पोर्टल से आवेदन करें।
conflict_flags: Maharashtra income limit for freeship is Rs. 8 lakh; central post-matric scholarship income limit is Rs. 2.5 lakh — students earning Rs. 2.5–8 lakh get Maharashtra freeship but NO central scholarship — benefit gap.

maharashtra_state_schemes.scheme_name: Rajarshi Shahu Maharaj Foreign Scholarship for SC (Maharashtra)
maharashtra_state_schemes.department: Social Justice & Special Assistance Dept, Maharashtra
maharashtra_state_schemes.description: Foreign scholarship for SC boys and girls from Maharashtra to pursue special studies abroad (Masters/PhD).
maharashtra_state_schemes.benefits: Full tuition fee abroad; living allowance as per country; travel grant; contingency allowance
application_process: Documents verified by Social Welfare Dept
maharashtra_state_schemes.language_summary_hi: Maharashtra के SC छात्रों को विदेश में उच्च शिक्षा के लिए पूरी छात्रवृत्ति।

maharashtra_state_schemes.scheme_name: Maharashtra Tribal Housing Scheme — Ghar Bandhani Yojana
maharashtra_state_schemes.description: Housing assistance to ST families in Maharashtra's tribal areas for construction of pucca houses.
maharashtra_state_schemes.benefits: Rs. 1.50 lakh state grant + PMAY-G central component where applicable; material and labour support
application_process: Apply at Gram Panchayat / Taluka Tribal Office
maharashtra_state_schemes.language_summary_hi: Maharashtra में ST परिवारों को घर बनाने के लिए 1.50 लाख रुपए की मदद।

maharashtra_state_schemes.scheme_name: Sant Rohidas Leather Industries & Charmakar Development Corporation Loan
maharashtra_state_schemes.department: Social Justice & Special Assistance Dept / Sant Rohidas Corporation
maharashtra_state_schemes.description: Concessional loans to SC Chamar/leather artisan communities in Maharashtra for toolkits, business expansion and self-employment.

eligibility.income_limit: Annual family income up to Rs. 3 lakh

maharashtra_state_schemes.benefits: Loans up to Rs. 1 lakh at 4–6% interest; toolkit grant up to Rs. 15,000; skill training in leather crafts
application_process: Apply at Sant Rohidas Corporation district office
maharashtra_state_schemes.language_summary_hi: Maharashtra में SC चर्मकार समुदाय को कम ब्याज पर ऋण और टूलकिट।

maharashtra_state_schemes.scheme_name: Maharashtra Tribal Health Scheme — Free Medical Treatment for ST
maharashtra_state_schemes.department: Tribal Development Department / Health Dept, Maharashtra
maharashtra_state_schemes.description: Free or highly subsidised medical treatment at government hospitals for ST patients; dedicated tribal hospitals in Thane, Nashik, Amravati, Nagpur divisions.
maharashtra_state_schemes.benefits: Free OPD and IPD treatment at government and tribal hospitals; free medicines; referral to tertiary care with travel allowance; Rs. 500 travel allowance per referral
application_process: Visit nearest PHC or Tribal Hospital
maharashtra_state_schemes.language_summary_hi: Maharashtra में ST परिवारों को सरकारी अस्पताल में मुफ्त इलाज और दवाइयां।

conflict_summary.description: Central scheme income limit Rs. 2.5 lakh; Gujarat state scheme income limit Rs. 1.5 lakh. SC student with family income Rs. 1.5–2.5 lakh qualifies centrally but NOT under Gujarat state scheme.
conflict_summary.resolution: Recommend central scheme; flag Gujarat state scheme as ineligible for this income range.

conflict_summary.description: Central ST post-matric scholarship: Rs. 2.5 lakh income limit. Gujarat state ST scheme: Rs. 2 lakh income limit. ST student with income Rs. 2–2.5 lakh qualifies centrally but NOT under Gujarat state.
conflict_summary.resolution: Apply centrally only; Gujarat state component not available for Rs. 2–2.5 lakh income.

conflict_summary.description: Central PMAY-G uses SECC-2011 listing only. Gujarat state top-up requires Gujarat Domicile Certificate. SC families listed in SECC but without Gujarat domicile (recent migrants) get central grant but miss state top-up.
conflict_summary.resolution: Flag explicitly: Get domicile certificate from Mamlatdar office to claim state top-up.

conflict_summary.description: PM-KISAN allows tenant and sharecropper ST farmers via self-declaration. Gujarat TASP Horticulture subsidy requires 7/12 Utara in applicant's name. Tenant ST farmers get PM-KISAN but are excluded from iKhedut/TASP schemes.
conflict_summary.resolution: Alert tenant farmers: entitled to PM-KISAN, NOT eligible for equipment/horticulture subsidy under TASP without land ownership proof.

conflict_summary.description: PMJAY uses SECC-2011 data; state health top-ups (Gujarat MA Yojana, Rajasthan Chiranjeevi) use state BPL lists. SC/ST families in SECC but not state BPL list get PMJAY but miss state top-up schemes.
conflict_summary.resolution: Get name added to state BPL list via District Collector or Food Dept to claim both benefits.

conflict_summary.description: Both PMMVY and Gujarat Namo Shri provide maternity benefits to SC/ST women. PMMVY requires husband's Aadhaar; Namo Shri only needs MCP card. Benefits are additive but documentation requirements differ — some women fail PMMVY Aadhaar requirement while qualifying for Namo Shri.
conflict_summary.resolution: Apply for both independently. For PMMVY, ensure husband's Aadhaar is linked. Namo Shri can be claimed via Anganwadi even if PMMVY fails.

conflict_summary.type: Income Limit — Maharashtra Freeship vs Central
conflict_summary.description: Maharashtra ST Freeship covers income up to Rs. 8 lakh (fees only); central scholarship covers only up to Rs. 2.5 lakh (fees + maintenance). Students earning Rs. 2.5–8 lakh get Maharashtra fee waiver but NO central scholarship maintenance allowance.
conflict_summary.resolution: Apply Maharashtra Freeship for fee; cannot apply central scholarship simultaneously — benefit gap in maintenance allowance for Rs. 2.5–8 lakh income group.
